title: A monohybrid cross: Tt × Tt
caption: Two heterozygous parents each make T and t gametes in equal numbers. The square gives 1 TT : 2 Tt : 1 tt, and because T is dominant, three tall plants for every short one. These are probabilities: a small family can differ.
alt: A Punnett square of two heterozygous tall pea plants: the offspring are one TT, two Tt and one tt.
description: Each parent is Tt and makes T and t gametes.
The four squares give TT, Tt, Tt and tt.
